test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In September 2024, Prime Minister Modi launched how many Param Rudra Super Computing Systems and a High Performance Computing (HPC) system for weather and climate research?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In September 2024, Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched 3 Param Rudra Super Computing Systems.
 
• The launch also included a High Performance Computing (HPC) system dedicated to weather and climate research.
 
• The Param Rudra systems are part of India's efforts to enhance computational capabilities for scientific research.
 
• These systems are expected to significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of weather forecasting and climate modeling.
 
• The initiative aligns with the Indian government's focus on leveraging technology for sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Supercomputing in India**

 
 
• India has been actively developing its supercomputing capabilities under the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM).
 
• The mission aims to build a network of supercomputers with a total computing capacity of 45 Petaflops.
 
• Supercomputers are crucial for advancing research in various fields including weather forecasting, climate science, and material science.
 
 
 
• **High Performance Computing (HPC)**
 
 
• HPC involves aggregating computing power to deliver higher performance than typical desktop computers and servers.
 
• It is essential for solving complex scientific, engineering, and business problems.
 
• HPC systems can process vast amounts of data and perform a large number of calculations at high speed.
 
 
 
• **Weather and Climate Research**
 
 
• Advanced computing systems play a pivotal role in enhancing the precision of weather predictions.
 
• Climate models require substantial computational power to simulate the Earth's climate and predict future changes.
 
• Accurate weather forecasting helps in disaster management and mitigation, saving lives and property.
 
 
 
• **Param Supercomputers**
 
 
• Param is a series of supercomputers developed by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) in India.
 
• The name "Param" means "supreme" in Sanskrit.
 
• These systems are designed to meet the growing computational demands of scientific research and industrial applications in India.
